race.description: George's Tree Services Don Terry Mdn Plate
race.comment: DIVINE MANDATE (1) is a two-start Maiden who placed on debut then could only manage sixth over 1430m at this track. Blinkers added and happy to have him on top. PEARL OF SICILY (8) again failed to feature last start, finishing tenth over 1540m at the Gold Coast Poly. Comes down a level this time. Among the leading chances in this company. LADY TUATARA (7) gave away a big start at the top of the straight last start and finished fifth over 1400m at Ballina. Suited in this line up and is among the better hopes. SAVANNA GOLDEN BOY (4) was out of the money two runs back when fresh from a spell then again missed the frame last start over 1250m at Ballina when fourth. Nicely placed to find some form.
